newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates stay high in tight market.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates stay high in tight market.

text.p: Pakistan interbank overnight rates remained high on Tuesday due to a shortage of funds in the banking system, dealers said.
With no change in overnights, all trades took place at 20 percent, one dealer of KASB & Co said.
He attributed the shortage to an outflow from the system and said an inflow of three billion rupees due maturing short-term federal bonds failed to loosen the market.
Banks crowded the central bank's discount window, the dealer said.
